rationale: For each sample reactive current iq = clip(k*(deadband - V), 0, current_limit) when V < deadband, else 0. Active current id = min(prefault_active, sqrt(current_limit^2 - iq^2)) so reactive current has priority and the total is bounded by the 1.2 pu limit. Total current is the magnitude sqrt(id^2 + iq^2). All samples remain above the 0.45 pu FRT voltage floor for the full event (max low-voltage duration < 0.2 s) and the reactive-current requirement is fully met, so ride-through is compliant.
